//: Copy to config.json and fill in your values. Never commit config.json. searchBackend is intentionally NOT set here: Codex is main source when credentials are available (CODEX_ACCESS_TOKEN or ~/.codex/auth.json); all configured available providers run in parallel, dedupe URLs, then optionally semantic-rerank results. SEARCH_BACKEND only controls fallback ordering.

tavily.//: Tavily search API (V3.4). API key free at tavily.com. Uses TAVILY_API_KEY env var.

documentParsing.//: In-process document & multimodal parsing. On by default; auto-discovers pdf-parse/officeparser and degrades gracefully if absent. Set DOCUMENT_PARSING_ENABLED=false (or enabled=false here) to disable. Multimodal VLM tier remains opt-in.

domainTrust.//: Opt-in domain reputation filtering. Off by default.

llm.//: OpenAI-compatible LLM for agentic_browse focus action and content extraction.

duckduckgo.//: Zero-key fallback search (V3.3.1). Region / safeSearch configurable via env vars.

ollamaSearch.//: Opt-in Ollama web-search backend (V3.3.1). Uses SEARCH_OLLAMA_* env vars — distinct from EMBEDDING_OLLAMA_*.

browser.//: CDP Browser Control (V5.2). Opt-in, disabled by default. Requires playwright-core. Three modes:
browser.//-mode-stealth: stealth = autonomous browser session. Set browserEngine=cloak to use the optional CloakBrowser binary instead of stock Playwright Chromium.
browser.//-mode-user: user = connect to your existing Chrome browser via CDP. Zero stealth needed — uses your real fingerprint and sessions.
browser.//-mode-profile: profile = launch Chrome/CloakBrowser with a persistent user data directory. Pre-authenticate once, reuse across sessions.
browser.//browserEngine: Set to 'cloak' to use npm package cloakbrowser as the launch backend. Install optional deps first: npm install cloakbrowser playwright-core.

rescoreWeights.//: Per-tool rescoring weights. Tune these to prioritize recency, citations, engagement, etc. rrfAnchor should dominate any single other signal.
